### Findings refused

- Unit 26 i "was founded" for ተሐንጸት "was built": a land is said to be founded; sense and force hold. Left.
- Unit 27 l keeps the raw "፨ ፨ ፨ ፨": published parts are mixed (some keep ፨ in l, some use ". . . ."); no house rule. Left.
- Unit 22 i "The owner of these" (ዝንቱአ is singular "this"): the pledges are three objects and the note already flags the final -አ (?). Left.
- Unit 17 both ሀገሮሙ rendered "their city"/"their own city": the note already flags the reference (?); not resolvable from the text.
- Unit 10 "sent word" for ለአከ: the note says message or messenger; the English is faithful to the context. Left.
- Unit 19 / 6 / 11 / 23 quotations of Genesis in notes (e.g. "She is more righteous than I"): they are marked as the biblical parallel for the reader, not used as the rendering; i is built from the Geʿez. Left.
- Unit 4 ኢይሰመይ "passive": left as written; the stem is passive either way and no reader is misled.
- Unit 7 ሐሙሃ ለትዕማር: the ለ- may be a possessive ("father-in-law of Tamar") rather than object-marking; i is the same either way. Left, and the note's "repeats the object" is acceptable.
